title: Processes: Organic matter pools (AOM, SMB, SOM)
intro: Added organic matter (AOM1-3: crop residues, roots, manure) is decomposed by the soil microbial biomass (SMB1-2), which builds soil organic matter (SOM1-3) from slow to inert; each pool has a carbon and a nitrogen content with its own turnover and efficiency, and the C:N ratio decides whether nitrogen is mineralised or immobilised.
